items.experiment: Mechanism test, how early the length policy arrives: f = ln(M(sft025_cue)/M(base_cue)) / ln(M(sft1_cue)/M(base_cue)), M = median generated tokens of finished answers. This mechanism says the length is mostly installed at a = 0.25 (f near 0.8); the linear-path rival (WiSE-FT, length proportional to dose in log) gives about 0.25.
